summary: Square Mountain is a rare 1931 Nez Perce L-5 log cabin lookout, abandoned in the early 1970s and under restoration since 1999.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in service in the early 1970s; under active restoration as of recent listings.

access.note: Under restoration; drive-up route exists but not open to the public to enter or climb.

visit.trail_note: Drive-up access; status listed as under restoration.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Nez Perce National Forest

events.note: Built as a Nez Perce L-5 log cabin lookout.
David Emmons recorded as staffing the lookout in 1972.
Lookout taken out of service in the early 1970s.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register on February 12, 2004.

evidence.supports: 1931 build as Nez Perce L-5 log cabin
evidence.quote: Built in 1931 and in service until the 1970s, the cabin is being carefully restored

evidence.supports: Considered one of the best surviving Nez Perce L-5 cabins on the forest
evidence.quote: There were only a few of the famed "Nez Perce L-5" log cabin lookouts built, and Square Mountain is one of the best of the last on the Nez Perce National Forest.
This Nez Perce L-5 log cabin, built in 1931, was abandoned in the early 1970's.

evidence.supports: Restoration by Historic Preservation Team and Passport in Time, lightning protection from FFLA chapter
evidence.quote: the cabin is being carefully restored by the regional Historic Preservation Team and a Pass Passport In Time project with lightning protection materials from the Idaho/Montana FFLA chapter
Restoration work has been ongoing since 1999.

notes_for_editor: Brief's status field 'standing' is consistent with sources (structure exists, under restoration, not destroyed); added status_note to flag it is not a routinely staffed or open lookout.
